content:
Goal: Create a wide comparison sheet showing the same chibi/anime musician scene rendered in exactly 30 different visual styles, arranged as a labeled thumbnail grid. The subject is {argument name="character description" default="a silver-haired chibi anime girl with twin buns and long curls, wearing a pale blue and white futuristic idol outfit, holding an electric guitar, with a bulky steampunk-mechanical backpack and glowing blue circular gear details"}. The setting is {argument name="setting" default="an outdoor music festival with a cheering crowd, stage, tents, blue sky, and a stage sign reading Frost+Beats"}.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image, like a contact sheet or style sampler. Use 5 rows by 6 columns for exactly 30 rectangular panels. Each panel has a thin border and a small black label box in the top-left corner with white text.

Layout: Keep the same core composition in every panel: the character is centered or slightly right of center, holding the guitar diagonally across the body, with the crowd and festival stage behind her. Vary only the visual rendering style per panel. Some panels may crop closer or blur the background, but the subject and guitar should remain recognizable.

Panel labels: Use exactly 30 numbered labels, one per panel, in this order from left to right and top to bottom: {argument name="style label set" default="1. 実写風, 2. アニメ風, 3. ドット風, 4. ローポリ風, 5. ペーパークラフト風, 6. 水彩画風, 7. 油絵風, 8. 鉛筆スケッチ風, 9. 線画風, 10. マンガ風, 11. レトロアニメ風, 12. サイバーパンク風, 13. スチームパンク風, 14. ファンタジー風, 15. ミニマル風, 16. ポップアート風, 17. ネオン風, 18. 和風（浮世絵風）, 19. グリッチアート風, 20. 白黒写真風, 21. セピア調, 22. イラストレーション風, 23. カートゥーン風, 24. 3Dリアル風, 25. クレイアート風, 26. 切り絵風, 27. 織物風, 28. ステンドグラス風, 29. ソーシャルゲーム風, 30. ちびキャラ風"}.

Style details for the 30 panels: 1 photorealistic festival shot, 2 polished anime key visual, 3 pixel-art blocks, 4 low-poly 3D, 5 layered paper craft, 6 soft watercolor, 7 textured oil painting, 8 pencil sketch, 9 clean monochrome line art, 10 dramatic black-and-white manga with sound effects, 11 aged retro anime cel look, 12 neon cyberpunk concert, 13 brown brass steampunk, 14 icy magical fantasy, 15 simplified minimal illustration, 16 colorful pop-art halftone, 17 glowing neon outline art, 18 traditional Japanese ukiyo-e-inspired print, 19 RGB glitch distortion, 20 black-and-white photograph, 21 sepia vintage photo, 22 clean modern illustration, 23 cartoon style, 24 realistic 3D render with depth of field, 25 clay/miniature figure diorama, 26 blue-and-white paper cutout, 27 woven tapestry texture, 28 stained-glass mosaic, 29 mobile/social-game promotional splash art, 30 extra-small chibi mascot style.

Visual style: Bright, colorful, playful, dense but readable. The whole sheet should look like a generated style comparison for one character prompt. Use consistent subject identity across panels, with silver hair, blue accents, guitar, mechanical gear backpack, and festival crowd repeated throughout.

Constraints: Include exactly 30 panels, exactly one label per panel, and no extra panels. Do not add captions outside the grid. Preserve the festival sign text {argument name="stage sign text" default="Frost+Beats"} in several backgrounds. Keep labels legible, black rectangles with white text.

Goal: Create an ornate anime character reference sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Celestine"}, a gentle celestial cat-maid original character.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 character sheet, pale ivory parchment background with subtle paper texture, thin gold corner filigree, teal accent lines, tiny feathers, sparkles, wing motifs, and delicate decorative dividers. Soft watercolor lighting, clean high-detail anime illustration, elegant fantasy maid aesthetic.

Main subject: Center-right full-body standing character, front view, occupying most of the page. She is a young anime girl with very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="turquoise teal"} hair, fluffy cat ears with white inner fur, a small ahoge, and a black bow on one ear. Her face is mostly covered by a soft square blur/placeholder while still showing the hairstyle and head silhouette. She has large white angel wings behind her. Outfit: black-and-white frilly maid dress with puff sleeves, white apron, layered ruffled skirt, navy-black outer skirt with gold constellation embroidery, red bow at collar, white thigh-high stockings, black Mary Jane shoes, white wrist cuffs, and a jeweled turquoise heart pendant with gold chains and tassel at the waist. Pose: graceful, slightly shy, one hand near the chest and the other holding the skirt hem outward.

Layout: Top left has a large elegant script title reading {argument name="display name" default="Celestine"}, with a small Japanese-style subtitle under it and tiny cat/wing ornaments. Beneath the title is a short profile block with 6 bullet lines using small teal icons: 1 paw icon for species, 2 wing icon for role, 3 heart icon for personality, 4 ribbon/scissors icon for favorite things, 5 star icon for disliked things, 6 music note icon for special skill. Top right contains a short poetic quote in Japanese-style typesetting, framed by small sparkles and a winged jewel emblem.

Expression panels: On the left side, include exactly 3 stacked square portrait panels labeled “Expressions.” Panel 1 shows the same character bust with the face area softly blurred/obscured, hands clasped near the chest. Panel 2 shows a visible happy closed-eye smile, hands clasped, cat ears perked. Panel 3 shows the character bust with the face softly blurred/obscured and a small teal question mark near the head, suggesting confusion. Each panel has a thin decorative teal border.

Back view: On the lower right, include exactly 1 smaller full-body rear-view figure labeled “Back Style.” Show the back of the teal hair, cat ears, black bow, large white angel wings, dark layered skirt with gold constellation embroidery, apron bow, stockings, and shoes.

Detail panels: Along the bottom left, include exactly 4 rectangular close-up panels labeled “Detail”: 1 collar and red bow with ruffled bodice, 2 waist apron and turquoise heart jewel chain ornament, 3 skirt hem with gold constellation embroidery and layered white ruffles, 4 black Mary Jane shoe with bow and small jewel charm.

Bottom right lore card: Add a small ornate framed card titled “Wings of the Celeste,” with several short centered lines of delicate Japanese-style text below and a small winged turquoise jewel emblem at the bottom.

Visual style: High-resolution polished anime art, soft pastel teal and navy palette, thin linework, translucent feather effects, elegant Victorian fantasy maid costume design, decorative reference-sheet typography. Keep the design clean and readable, with no modern UI elements, no watermark, and no extra characters.

Create a vertical semi-pixel-art fantasy character illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious armored warrior"} standing front-facing in the center, full body, imposing and symmetrical. The warrior wears ornate polished {argument name="armor color" default="silver and white"} plate armor with gold filigree trim, layered pauldrons, gauntlets, greaves, a dark cape, and a horned wing-like helmet with a black visor and small glowing amber eyes. The hands are clasped over the pommel of a huge vertical greatsword planted point-down in front of the body; the sword has an elaborate crossguard and a blue jewel near the lower ornament. Add exactly one small cute {argument name="shoulder companion" default="hamster"} perched on the warrior’s right shoulder, creating a humorous contrast with the intimidating armor. Surround the figure with a tall ornate gothic frame made of curling gold metalwork and exactly four large silver feathered wing ornaments: two at the upper left and upper right, and two at the lower left and lower right. Place a decorative crest at the top center and another at the bottom center aligned with the sword. Background: a dark gothic cathedral or fantasy city interior with arched windows, towers, balconies, warm lantern lights, misty blue shadows, and deep navy-gray tones. Style: detailed 16-bit / semi-pixel challenge aesthetic, crisp pixel edges, high-detail sprite shading, dramatic metallic highlights, symmetrical composition, dark fantasy mood with elegant beauty, no text, no watermark. Use a vertical smartphone-like composition, {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}.

Goal: Create a wide promotional collage showing four high-end AI-generated advertisement examples and a call-to-action banner for receiving prompt templates.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal image, approximately 1200×622 px, divided into a clean 2×2 grid of four equal advertising panels, with a full-width red banner along the bottom. Use polished commercial design quality, sharp typography, realistic lighting, premium gradients, and no visible watermarks.

Layout: Use exactly 5 discrete sections: 1 top-left luxury skincare ad, 2 top-right SaaS analytics ad, 3 bottom-left summer citrus sale ad, 4 bottom-right black-and-gold prompt giveaway ad, and 5 bottom red call-to-action banner. Thin borders separate the panels.

Panel 1, top-left luxury skincare ad: Create a soft beige silk background with warm golden light, a glass cosmetic bottle lying inside or beside a transparent spherical bubble, with elegant Japanese serif typography. Include a small gold label in the upper right reading “LIMITED”. Main Japanese headline: “うるおいの革命”. Subheadline: “初回限定 50% OFF”. Add a black strip along the bottom of this panel reading “LUXURY SKINCARE” in spaced gold letters. Mood: delicate, premium, luminous skincare.

Panel 2, top-right AI analytics ad: Create a futuristic nighttime office scene with blue neon holographic dashboard panels, city lights through windows, a glass desk, coffee cup, papers/tablet, and dark corporate atmosphere. Main card title: “AI-POWERED ANALYTICS”. Japanese headline: “チームの生産性が、3倍になる。” Supporting Japanese copy in smaller text. Add a gold rounded button reading “14日間 無料トライアル →”. Show exactly 2 metric cards on the right: “MONTHLY REVENUE ¥4.2M ↑32%” and “ACTIVE USERS 12,480 ↑18%”. Show exactly 3 small pill labels under them: “AI REPORT”, “AUTO SYNC”, and “REAL-TIME”.

Panel 3, bottom-left summer sale ad: Create a bright orange citrus splash advertisement with sliced oranges, lime wedges, lemon pieces, sparkling water droplets, ice cubes, and energetic summer lighting. Text: “SUMMER 2026” above a huge white “SALE”. Japanese text below: “夏の大特価”. Add a cream rounded discount badge reading “最大 60% OFF”. Add date range at bottom: “7.1 TUE — 7.31 THU”. Mood: fresh, juicy, high-impact retail banner.

Panel 4, bottom-right prompt giveaway ad: Create a black luxury background with ornate gold Art Deco borders, brass gears, steampunk clockwork elements, and metallic gold typography. Top text: “SPECIAL RELEASE”. Huge center text: “30” and below it “PROMPTS”. Japanese line: “広告画像を量産するプロンプト全30選”. Add a gold rounded button reading “いいね＆リプで受け取る”. Bottom small note: “※ GPT Image-2（ChatGPT Images 2.0）対応”. Mood: exclusive, premium, campaign giveaway.

Bottom banner: Add a full-width deep red velvet-like strip with ornate gold corner decorations and a thin gold border. Large gold Japanese call-to-action text centered: {argument name="bottom call to action" default="いいね＆リプライで「デザイナー」"}. Make it bold, embossed, and readable.

Visual style: Ultra-polished advertising mockup, realistic product photography mixed with digital UI graphics, gold highlights, glossy surfaces, crisp composition, high contrast between panels, professional social media promotional image.

Constraints: Include exactly 4 ad panels plus 1 bottom banner. Keep all specified visible text legible and placed as described. Do not add extra panels, logos, QR codes, people, or watermarks.

Create a moody, realistic vertical photo of a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a messy bun, sitting or leaning forward on a sofa in a dimly lit room at night. She wears a loose, semi-sheer {argument name="shirt color" default="white"} button-up shirt falling open at the collar, with soft folds and natural fabric texture. Her head is bent downward toward a glowing smartphone near the bottom right edge of the frame, one hand touching the screen so the phone casts a small cool white-blue light on her fingers. Compose the image as an intimate close-up from chest to head, cropped tightly, with her face mostly hidden by her posture and covered by a large opaque rectangular privacy block in muted dark brown-gray over the right-center face area. Background is dark, soft, and out of focus, suggesting a couch or wall, with low-key cinematic lighting, subtle grain, shallow depth of field, realistic skin tones, and a quiet melancholic atmosphere. Use a vertical {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} composition, no visible text, no watermark, no extra objects.

Goal: Create a vertical social-media image where a realistic cafe photo is overlaid with playful hand-drawn imagination doodles, as if emotions and thoughts are spilling out onto the scene.

Canvas: Vertical 9:16 composition, close-up perspective, warm shallow-depth-of-field photography. The main subject is {argument name="drink" default="a latte in a brown ceramic cup"} on a dark wooden table, sitting on a gray square coaster. The latte art is a large creamy heart shape in the foam, with golden-brown espresso crema around it. Background is softly blurred with a dark plate and pastry near the top edge.

Visual style: Keep the base image photorealistic, cozy, warm, and slightly moody, with natural cafe lighting and visible foam texture. Add energetic mixed-media doodles on top: white marker handwriting, black brush lettering, red and yellow crayon strokes, arrows, sparkles, hearts, underlines, scribbles, and tiny cartoon stick characters. The doodles should feel spontaneous, imperfect, emotional, and layered over the photo, not digitally polished.

Doodle text and labels: Include exactly 9 handwritten text callouts around the cup: 1) “why is this so good” in white at upper left with a pink heart and underline, 2) “BRO???” inside a speech bubble above the cup, 3) “LAST DANCE” in large black brush letters at upper right with yellow emphasis marks and a pink underline, 4) “this part tho...” on the left with a yellow arrow pointing to the latte surface, 5) “THIS IS CRAZY” in a speech bubble near the lower-left latte foam, 6) “WE STAYING HERE” in a speech bubble on the right side of the latte art, 7) “wait— look at this” on the right with a pink arrow pointing to the foam, 8) “silky smooth” at lower left with a white arrow pointing to the cup rim, 9) “layers on layers” inside a yellow circle at the bottom center with an arrow up to the cup, and 10) “that shine tho” at lower right with a white arrow pointing to the glossy foam.

Tiny character count: Add exactly 5 small doodled cartoon people interacting with the latte: 1) one standing on the upper rim with arms raised and a speech bubble saying “BRO???”, 2) one tiny red-capped character on the left rim pointing toward the foam, 3) one sliding down the latte surface on white drawn slide lines with the speech bubble “THIS IS CRAZY”, 4) one sitting near the right-center latte art with the speech bubble “WE STAYING HERE”, and 5) one on a small ladder at the right rim looking toward the foam.

Decorative doodle count: Add exactly 15 extra decorative marks around the scene: a small red star at upper left, two yellow stars near the lower left, one pink crown above the “LAST DANCE” text, one yellow lightning bolt on the right, two blue sparkles at lower right, one pink heart near the bottom, one white spiral scribble at bottom left, one yellow oval swirl at bottom left, one small beige spiral at bottom right, two long pink swoosh lines across the bottom, one long yellow swoosh near the bottom, and one short white scribble near the top left.

Constraints: Preserve the latte and table as a normal realistic photograph while making only the surrounding world visually noisy and imaginative. Use {argument name="main lettering phrase" default="LAST DANCE"} as the largest readable text. Keep all handwriting legible, rough, and hand-drawn. No watermark, no border, no extra UI elements.

Create a romantic dark-fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="couple description" default="a tall silver-haired nobleman embracing a petite long-haired woman"} on an ornate castle balcony at night. The composition is a close, intimate waist-up portrait: the man stands on the left, broad-shouldered, leaning down toward the woman as if about to kiss her forehead; the woman stands on the right, pressed against his chest, one hand clutching the chain and pendant on his coat while his black-gloved hand wraps protectively around her waist. Obscure both faces with two soft-edged muted gray-brown rectangular blocks, one larger square over the man's face and one vertical rectangle over the woman's face, while leaving the hair, clothing, and embrace visible. The man has windswept {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white hair"}, pale skin, a black high-collared gothic uniform, a dark cloak or mantle, leather gloves, layered gold chains, and large star-shaped crystal cross pendants. The woman has very long dark hair with jeweled star hair ornaments, a royal blue and white embroidered dress with gold filigree details, delicate earrings, and translucent layered sleeves. Set the scene in a luminous {argument name="setting" default="midnight blue palace garden balcony"} with elaborate wrought-iron railings, Gothic spires, glowing windows, hanging lanterns, blue roses, tiny fairy lights, drifting sparkles, and a star-filled sky. Use a rich blue, violet, silver, and warm lantern-gold palette, dramatic rim lighting on hair and shoulders, highly detailed fabric embroidery and jewelry, painterly anime rendering, cinematic depth of field, soft bloom, romantic melancholy atmosphere, no text, no watermark.

Create a sunlit anime-style travel illustration at {argument name="location" default="Kitayuzawa Onsen, Shiroginu no Toko riverside promenade"} in a lush Japanese mountain hot-spring town. The scene shows exactly two young women walking side by side on a stone sidewalk beside a wooden riverside railing: the left figure is {argument name="main character" default="a transparent soap-slime girl with a hollow glassy body, thick iridescent bubble-like membrane skin, rainbow highlights, short translucent pearly hair, and a floating soap-bubble halo"}, wearing a sheer off-shoulder frilly white summer dress, sandals, and a small pale shoulder bag, with one hand resting on the railing; the right figure is {argument name="companion character" default="a normal human young woman with long brown hair"}, wearing a cream blouse, a long blue-gray skirt, white sneakers, and carrying a black shoulder bag. Include exactly two shoulder bags, one pale bag on the slime girl and one black bag on the companion. Their faces are intentionally covered by soft rectangular beige blur masks, while the rest of the image is highly detailed. Behind them is a bright river with white rapids and rocks on the left, dense green forest, layered mountains, a vivid blue sky with puffy white clouds, and small roadside buildings on the right. Add exactly one dark roadside sign near the river reading 「北湯沢温泉」, 「白絹の床」, and small romanized text “Kita-Yuzawa Onsen / Shiroginu no Toko.” Use polished GPT-image anime realism, delicate linework, luminous summer lighting, dappled tree shadows, sparkling reflections on the slime body, and a peaceful sightseeing atmosphere. Aspect ratio 4:3.

Goal: Create a dramatic vertical manga page about a supernatural apocalypse in modern Sapporo, where a purple rift opens in the sky, a giant demon descends, and a schoolgirl hero with robotic allies prepares to fight.

Canvas: Tall comic page in a 3:4 vertical ratio, full-bleed artwork with thin white gutters and black panel borders. Use a polished high-detail anime/manga style with cinematic lighting, saturated neon colors, dense city detail, and intense action composition.

Layout: Use exactly 3 horizontal panels stacked vertically. Panel 1 occupies the top third, Panel 2 the middle third, and Panel 3 the bottom third. Add exactly 4 white jagged manga speech balloons with vertical Japanese text.

Panel 1: Nighttime downtown Sapporo cityscape seen from street level, crowded with shocked pedestrians looking upward. The Sapporo TV Tower stands on the left, glowing orange with signage reading “30-24 SAPPORO.” Above the skyline, the sky has split into a massive swirling purple vortex filled with lightning, stars, debris, and a single red reptilian eye at the center. Include exactly 2 speech balloons: one small jagged balloon on the left reading {argument name="left reaction text" default="なんだあれ!?"}, and one tall jagged balloon on the right reading {argument name="sky warning text" default="空が割れてる!!"}.

Panel 2: The vortex ruptures over a neon Japanese city intersection. A colossal demonic kaiju emerges from the purple storm, filling most of the frame. It has a muscular black-and-purple body, glowing red eyes, huge curved horns, ornate organic armor, clawed hands reaching toward the street, and a circular glowing sigil embedded in its chest. Cars crash and flip in the foreground, sparks and explosions scatter across the road, people run in panic, and buildings with neon signs frame both sides. Include exactly 1 tall jagged speech balloon on the right reading {argument name="demon proclamation" default="人間界ヲ焼キ払エ・・・!"}.

Panel 3: Hero reveal composition under a cherry-blossom-like shower of pink petals and purple cosmic light. Center foreground: a Japanese high school girl hero, {argument name="hero name" default="unnamed schoolgirl"}, standing confidently with long black hair blowing in the wind; her face is softly obscured or not sharply detailed. She wears a navy school blazer, white shirt, red ribbon tie, plaid skirt, and holds a glowing pink energy katana angled downward across the foreground. Around her are exactly 3 mechanical allies: 1 white robotic wolf with blue glowing eyes and blue cybernetic armor at lower left, 1 bulky gorilla-like armored robot with blue eyes and a huge red glowing cannon fist at lower right, and 1 silver-blue winged mecha bird hovering behind her on the upper right. The Sapporo tower is visible again in the background. Include exactly 1 white oval speech balloon on the left reading {argument name="hero line" default="また始まったか・・・"}.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed Japanese action manga/anime illustration, glossy digital painting, dramatic perspective, neon purple apocalypse lighting, electric effects, particles, debris, high contrast, intricate linework, cinematic depth, crisp panel art.

Constraints: Keep exactly 3 panels, exactly 4 speech balloons, exactly 3 robotic allies, and no extra captions or narration boxes. Preserve the Japanese text exactly as written inside the balloons. Do not add watermarks, artist signatures, UI elements, or English subtitles.

Create a full-body character concept art illustration of a steampunk adventurer gunslinger standing upright on a plain white background, centered and facing forward. The character is an androgynous young adult with {argument name="hair color" default="light blond"} medium-length tousled hair peeking from under a tall black-and-brown top hat decorated with brass goggles, gears, rivets, leather panels, and a small brass telescope attachment. The face should be intentionally obscured by a smooth featureless beige blur/blank oval with no eyes, nose, or mouth. Outfit: a Victorian steampunk ensemble in dark brown, black, and antique brass, including a long split leather trench coat, fitted double-breasted waistcoat, black high-collar shirt, cravat with a blue gem brooch, layered belts and holsters, pouches at the hip, brass buttons, shoulder armor plates, one mechanical brass gauntlet/prosthetic forearm, black gloves, fitted black trousers with straps, and tall dark leather boots. Pose: confident stance with legs apart, left hand resting on the hip, right arm raised holding one ornate brass flintlock pistol angled upward. Count exactly one visible weapon: the brass pistol. Use polished anime-inspired fantasy character-sheet rendering with crisp linework, detailed leather texture, metallic highlights, symmetrical front-view presentation, soft studio lighting, minimal shadows, no scenery, no text, no watermark.

Goal: Create a realistic dark-mode mobile cooking AI assistant interface showing recipe suggestions generated from fridge ingredients, in Japanese.

Canvas: Vertical smartphone screenshot, approximately 4:5 crop, black outer background with a centered app feed column. Use rounded corners, soft shadows, and a premium food-app aesthetic.

Layout: At the top, place one rounded dark charcoal chat bubble containing Japanese assistant text. Below it, show a vertically scrolling list of recipe cards. Exactly 2 recipe cards are visible: the first card is fully visible, the second card is only partially visible at the bottom.

Text content: The top chat bubble says: 「冷蔵庫の食材を活かし、フライパン一つで完結する健康的な10種のレシピをご提案します。味付けや調理法が重ならないよう、バリエーション豊かに構成しました。」 The first recipe card title says: 「鳥手羽元のエキゾチック酢煮込み」. Its description says: 「かんたん酢とニンニクを効かせた、中東風の爽やかでコクのある煮込みです。手羽元が驚くほど柔らかく仕上がります。」 The link text says: 「レシピを見る」.

Card details: Recipe card 1 has a large food photo on top and a dark information panel underneath. The photo shows {argument name="main dish" default="braised chicken drumettes with sliced onions in a light brown sauce"} served in a shallow beige ceramic bowl on a warm wooden table, photographed from a slightly overhead angle with natural restaurant lighting. Add black pepper specks on the chicken, glossy sauce, and soft depth of field. Place exactly 1 circular white heart-outline favorite button at the upper-right corner of the image area. The information panel below is very dark brown-black with the title in bold white, description in muted gray, and the recipe link in pale pink.

Second card: Show only the top portion of a second recipe card beneath the first, separated by vertical spacing. It should include a large cropped food photo showing a bowl of creamy pale-yellow noodles or soup on a wooden table, with exactly 1 circular white heart-outline favorite button at the upper-right corner. Do not show its title in the crop.

Visual style: Modern Japanese recipe app UI, dark theme, rounded 18–22 px cards, subtle borders, soft shadows, high-resolution food photography, clean sans-serif typography. Use warm browns, beige ceramic, black charcoal panels, and muted pink accent text.

Constraints: Include exactly 1 top chat bubble, exactly 2 visible recipe cards, and exactly 2 heart favorite buttons total. Keep the interface realistic and uncluttered, with no extra icons, navigation bars, watermarks, or English UI text.

Create a dreamy mythological fantasy illustration in a vertical 2:3 poster format. Use a luminous teal turquoise night-sky background with soft paper grain, tiny white stars, sparkles, and pastel celestial ornaments. In the upper center, depict an ethereal moon goddess floating in the sky beneath a large pale golden full moon; she wears flowing ancient East Asian-inspired robes made of translucent pastel ribbons in pink, lavender, mint, aqua, and pale yellow, trailing dramatically to the right like mist. Her black hair is styled in an elegant high bun with gold floral ornaments, and her face is softly obscured and painterly rather than detailed. Behind her, add a vertical aurora-like beam of watercolor light in blues, violets, greens, and pinks extending from top to bottom. Include exactly 4 large starburst shapes: one pale cyan four-point star near the upper left, one small pink star near the goddess, one large white four-point star to the right of the moon, and one yellow starburst near the middle right. Include exactly 5 round planet-like circles in warm pastel tones scattered through the scene: one peach circle on the left, one small orange circle near the goddess robe, one pale blue circle at lower right, one large translucent pale circle behind the flowering tree, and one peach circle near the lower left tree area. In the lower half, paint a delicate golden flowering tree with thin branches and many tiny yellow blossoms rising from the left side. At the bottom, create a landscape of rounded pastel cloud-hills in pink, cyan, lavender, blue, peach, and mint with watercolor texture and vertical soft streaks. Place a small white rabbit with pink eye and upright ears sitting on top of the central pink dome-shaped hill, gazing upward toward the goddess. Add fine glitter dust, shooting-star lines, and soft magical speckles throughout. Overall style: Japanese fairytale poster, watercolor gouache, pastel gradients, celestial mythology, soft edges, whimsical, serene, high detail, no text, no border, no watermark.

Create a square 1:1 ultra-detailed origami paper-craft portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a stylish young Korean pop idol"} shown from the chest up in a three-quarter profile facing right, with the facial area deliberately covered by a smooth centered square censor block in a warm taupe-brown gradient. The subject has layered tousled {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair made from sharp folded paper facets, a visible left ear with two dangling silver earrings, and a dramatic angular {argument name="jacket color" default="metallic gold"} hooded jacket over a black inner shirt, all constructed from folded triangular paper panels with crisp creases, shadows, and realistic handmade texture. The background is an ornate Japanese-inspired origami collage with black and charcoal mountains, cream paper planes, gold foil accents, and exactly 3 large fan or sunburst shapes: one gold semicircle at upper left, one cream folded fan at left center, and one cream folded fan at right center. Include exactly 12 visible origami flowers: 2 large white flowers with gold stamens at the upper left and upper right, 1 small pale pink flower on the left edge, 2 pink flowers near the lower-left edge, 5 pink cherry blossoms on the lower-right branch, and 2 white cherry blossoms on the lower-right branch. Use a premium editorial fashion-poster composition, shallow paper-relief depth, warm studio lighting, high contrast between matte black paper and metallic gold paper, intricate crease lines, handcrafted shadows, and no readable text or watermark. Keep the face censor square clean and flat while the rest of the image remains highly detailed.

Goal: Create a simple chibi game sprite sheet for a desktop pet character, showing exactly 6 full-body sprites of the same anime girl aligned in one horizontal row.

Canvas: Wide landscape canvas, about 690 x 613 px, with a flat bright chroma-key green background filling the entire image. Leave large empty green space above and below the sprite row, and place the characters across the upper-middle area.

Character design: A petite chibi anime girl named {argument name="character name" default="Codex desktop pet"} with very pale skin, oversized head, short white-silver bob hair, small ahoge curl on top, long side locks, and purple flower hair ornaments on both sides with thin black ribbon tassels. She wears a white gothic-lolita maid-style dress with dark navy-black trim, puff sleeves, a bow at the collar, purple floral embroidery near the hem, a short flared skirt, black garter-like strap details, white knee socks, and chunky white lace-up boots with dark soles. Use clean 2D anime rendering, soft cel shading, crisp outlines, and a cute toy-like proportions style.

Sprite count and poses: Include exactly 6 discrete character sprites, evenly spaced left to right, all facing forward and standing upright with small variations in arm and body position. The 6 sprites are: 1) front-facing neutral standing pose with face area covered by a square gray placeholder block, 2) front-facing neutral standing pose with face area covered by a square gray placeholder block, 3) front-facing neutral standing pose with face area covered by a square gray placeholder block, 4) front-facing neutral standing pose with face area covered by a square gray placeholder block, 5) front-facing visible face pose with closed eyes and a calm sleepy expression, no placeholder block, 6) front-facing neutral standing pose with face area covered by a square gray placeholder block.
